name: Shrike Security MCP Server
description: Protects AI agents from threats like prompt injection, jailbreaks, and SQL injection through a multi-layer scanning pipeline. It also enables PII redaction and rehydration to ensure data privacy during LLM interactions.

SHRIKE_API_KEY.description: API key for authenticated scans (enables L7/L8 LLM layers). Without an API key, scans run on the free tier (regex-only layers L1–L4).

SHRIKE_BACKEND_URL.description: URL of the Shrike backend API.

MCP_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE.description: Max requests per minute per customer.
